race.comment: KILLIANA (6) is the top pick fresh, with a Flemington trial win two weeks ago suggesting she's come back well. Her final run last campaign can be treated more kindly after she raced wide and was tightened late at Cranbourne, while the earlier BM70 sixth at the Heath was much better than it reads, beaten just under three lengths as favourite. ZIGGY BAMA (3) is the clear danger, with two wins and one placing from four starts at around this distance and an excellent record with Fred W Kersley. He was beaten just over seven lengths as favourite last time, but the prior Warrnambool win over Bifrost is strong enough to keep him high in calculations. CARIBBEAN VILLA (9) has been costly to win with, yet the neck second at Horsham last week gives him a genuine each-way case. COMMANDS SUCCESS (4) improved into a Seymour third and has a deep distance record, so he appeals as the steadier place hope if he holds that form.
